text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
It is rare for thee to invite me to a "VR 
Sengoku Game".

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before, No Reason defeated an enemy over 
three meters tall right before our eyes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, I didn't think she could 
win. Yet, she refused to give up—and 
seized victory."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, as her Trainer, I will show No 
Reason—my determination.
choice_data_list: Hey, wanna try Versus Mode?

text_block_list.name: No Reason: Warlord
text_block_list.text: You say you wish to face me in battle?

text_block_list.name: No Reason: Warlord
text_block_list.text:
Of course, thou art aware of our 
difference in physical prowess, yes? —Dost 
thou require a handicap?
choice_data_list: I don't need it.

text_block_list.name: No Reason: Warlord
text_block_list.text: ...Hooh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I am fully aware of the disparity in 
physical ability. That is precisely why I 
have formulated a strategy. Our 
objective—is nothing less than victory!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Bzzzz... bzzzz...)

text_block_list.name: No Reason: Warlord
text_block_list.text: —Hm? This sound...

text_block_list.name: No Reason: Warlord
text_block_list.text: Eeeeeeeeeeek!!!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason: Warlord
text_block_list.text:
Th-There's no meow-stooke! Bugs!! It's 
them!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason: Warlord
text_block_list.text:
She was so full of confidence... Did she 
really think she could catch me off guard 
with a bug!?

text_block_list.name: No Reason: Warlord
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you ready! Now, let us fight fair 
and square...!!
choice_data_list: Let's settle this!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason: Warlord
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What's the matter with you?! You were 
full of fight a second ago, yet you won't 
even approach me!
choice_data_list: Aren't you the one running away?
Aren't you the one running away?

text_block_list.name: No Reason: Warlord
text_block_list.text:
I am NOT running away! I'm just gauging 
the distance!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason: Warlord
text_block_list.text:
(That said... wh-when is this guy ever 
gonna get the bug—)
choice_data_list: You're wide open!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason: Warlord
text_block_list.text: Danger-meow!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason: Warlord
text_block_list.text:
—D-Damn it. I'm thinking about bugs far 
too much!

text_block_list.name: No Reason: Warlord
text_block_list.text: Ngh... in that case!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason: Warlord
text_block_list.text:
Before they bring out the bugs, I'll take 
'em down!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason took off with immense momentum. 
An Umamusume's top speed exceeds 60 km/h— 
the same as a car.
choice_data_list: Alright! Here it comes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She will reach the limit of her patience 
eventually. I already foresaw that things 
would turn out like this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I start running at No Reason's pace. I 
"deliberately" let her chase my back—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she's like a car, she can be easily 
caught. However, if she's like a car, she 
won't be able to stop easily!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A sudden stop always creates a massive 
opening. In order to catch her off guard—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I come to a sudden halt and spin around 
on my heel. Startled, No Reason loses her 
balance.

text_block_list.name: No Reason: Warlord
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaaat in the wooooorld!!?
choice_data_list: No Reason, got you!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Guh~... I went and lost, huh...
choice_data_list: We did it! We won!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"What is it? You seem awfully pleased with 
yourself, hmm?"
choice_data_list: Yeah! Because I wanted to beat you first.
Yeah! Because I wanted to beat you first!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Hm? For me?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"If you believe you won't lose, you will 
not lose."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day No Reason first invited me to play 
a game— she brought down an NPC over three 
meters tall.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The difference in skill was obvious. To be 
honest, I thought winning was impossible.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“Still, the outcome was different. 
Formulating a plan to win—they fought on.”
choice_data_list: Watching you fight gave me courage.
Seeing you fight gave me courage.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: ――...Nyahaha~! As expected of yours truly!
choice_data_list:
Someday, let's pull off a historic upset 
together, just the two of us.

Next time, as your strategist, I will 
support you flawlessly.

Next time, I'll support you perfectly as 
your strategist.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: ――...Nyahaha~! As expected of yours truly!
choice_data_list:
Someday, let's pull off a historic upset 
together, just the two of us.

Next time, as your strategist, I will 
support you flawlessly.

Next time, I'll support you perfectly as 
your strategist.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Do not state the obvious! Besides...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Because I believe in you! Nyahaha~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As long as you never give up, you can 
overcome the odds. Now that I've truly 
felt that—
choice_data_list: No Reason, I have a favor to ask

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I shared the plan I'd been turning over in 
my head with her. No Reason responded with 
a broad grin.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"I had some expectations of you, indeed! 
Keep up this performance in future battles 
as well."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As long as you never give up, you can 
overcome the odds. Now that I've truly 
felt that, taking on that "big role"—
choice_data_list: No Reason, I have a favor to ask

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I shared the plan I'd been turning over in 
my head with her. No Reason responded with 
a broad grin.
